channel.title: 麻将文章 · Mahjong Articles — Too Apps
channel.description: 中英双语麻将文章：规则、地方玩法、番种算分、策略技巧与 AI 教学。Bilingual mahjong articles on rules, variants, scoring, strategy and AI.

item.title: 新手如何学打麻将：从零开始的完整路线
item.description: 完全不懂麻将？本文按一个清晰顺序，带你从认识牌面一路走到第一次成功胡牌。 — Never played mahjong? Follow one clear order — from learning the tiles to your first winning hand.

item.title: 麻将新手最常见的 10 个错误
item.description: 总在同一个地方输牌？这 10 个新手错误几乎人人都会犯，看看你中了几个。 — Losing in the same spot every time? These 10 beginner mistakes are nearly universal — see how many are yours.

item.title: 麻将一共多少张牌？几个人玩？
item.description: 144 张牌、4 个人——这个说法对吗？不同玩法其实并不一样，一次讲清楚。 — 144 tiles, 4 players — is that always right? Different variants differ; here's the full picture.

item.title: 麻将术语入门：吃、碰、杠、听、胡
item.description: 听不懂牌桌上的黑话？这五个核心术语搞懂，你就能跟上节奏了。 — Lost in table talk? Nail these five core terms and you'll keep up with the pace.

item.title: 麻将怎么算分？新手也能看懂的点数入门
item.description: 和牌了却不知道该收多少分？先搞懂「番」和「点」这两个概念就够了。 — Won the hand but unsure what to collect? Understanding "fan" and "points" is enough to start.

item.title: 三人麻将怎么玩？规则与新手技巧
item.description: 牌友凑不齐四个人？三人麻将节奏更快、更刺激，规则也更好上手。 — Can't find a fourth? Three-player mahjong is faster, punchier and easier to pick up.

item.title: 麻将新手 30 天练习计划
item.description: 想尽快上手却不知道练什么？这份 30 天计划把目标拆成每周可执行的小任务。 — Want to improve fast but unsure what to practise? This 30-day plan breaks it into weekly tasks.

item.title: 2026 年值得一试的麻将练习 App
item.description: 一个人也能练麻将？选对 App，就能把碎片时间变成有效训练。 — Practising solo? The right app turns spare minutes into real training.

item.title: 打麻将会变聪明吗？关于脑力训练的真相
item.description: 麻将常被称为「脑力运动」，它到底锻炼了哪些能力？科学怎么看？ — Mahjong is often called a "brain sport" — which skills does it really train, and what does science say?

item.title: 麻将和扑克有什么区别？
item.description: 都会读牌、都要算概率，麻将和扑克到底像在哪、又差在哪？ — Both involve reading opponents and counting odds — where do mahjong and poker align, and where do they diverge?

item.title: 跟着走一遍：我的第一局麻将
item.description: 规则看了不少还是不敢上桌？跟着这一局，把每个环节实际走一遍。 — Read plenty of rules but still afraid to sit down? Follow one hand, step by step.

item.title: 新手如何看牌：一眼读懂自己的手牌
item.description: 拿到 13 张牌一片茫然？学会「分堆」和「找骨架」，看牌速度立刻提升。 — Staring blankly at 13 tiles? Learn to group them and spot the frame, and you'll read instantly.

item.title: 麻将牌面构成详解：万筒条与字牌
item.description: 108 张序数牌 + 28 张字牌 + 8 张花牌 = 144 张。拆开看，构成其实非常规整。 — 108 number tiles + 28 honor tiles + 8 flowers = 144. Broken down, the set is remarkably regular.

item.title: 座位、庄家与风向：麻将的方向规则
item.description: 为什么有人是东家、有人是南家？座位和庄家更替看似琐碎，却影响全场节奏。 — Why is one player East and another South? Seating and dealer rotation look minor but shape the whole session.

item.title: 摸牌、打牌与轮转：一局的基本流程
item.description: 麻将的全部动作，其实就是一个循环：摸一张、打一张、别人响应。 — Every mahjong turn is one loop: draw a tile, discard a tile, others respond.

item.title: 什么是胡牌？和牌基本型全解
item.description: 四组面子 + 一对将，这是所有和牌的共同骨架。特殊型也都是它的变体。 — Four melds plus a pair — the shared skeleton of every winning hand, special shapes included.

item.title: 门清与副露：闭门造车还是敞开手脚？
item.description: 吃碰之后叫「副露」，不碰不吃叫「门清」。两者各有代价，怎么选大有讲究。 — Calling tiles makes a hand "open"; never calling keeps it "concealed". Each has a cost — choosing well matters.

item.title: 吃、碰、杠到底怎么区分？
item.description: 三个动作都叫「副露」，但触发条件、牌数、优先级完全不同。 — All three are "calls", yet their triggers, tile counts and priority differ completely.

item.title: 杠的种类：明杠、暗杠、加杠
item.description: 杠不是只有一种。明杠、暗杠、加杠在信息暴露和番数上都不一样。 — Kong isn't just one thing — open, concealed and added kongs differ in exposure and value.

item.title: 听牌与报听：离胡牌只差一张
item.description: 听牌了要不要报？报听有什么好处和风险？规则差异一次讲清。 — Ready — should you declare it? The benefits and risks of announcing tenpai, across variants.

item.title: 番与点数：麻将分数的两块基石
item.description: 番决定「值多少」，点数决定「收多少」。搞清二者关系，算分不再糊涂。 — Fan says "how much it's worth"; points say "how much you collect". Clarify the link and scoring stops confusing you.

item.title: 开局规则：骰子、牌墙与开门
item.description: 掷骰子不只是仪式：它决定了从哪里开始摸牌。 — Rolling dice isn't just ritual — it decides where drawing begins.

item.title: 花牌怎么算？春夏秋冬与梅兰竹菊
item.description: 摸到花牌为什么要补牌？花牌到底加多少分？规则一次说清。 — Why draw a replacement for a flower? How much do flowers score? The rules, explained.

item.title: 特殊和牌型：七对、十三幺与更多
item.description: 除了「四面子一将」，麻将还有几种不按常理出牌的和牌型。 — Beyond "four melds and a pair", mahjong has several hands that break the usual rules.

item.title: 流局与荒牌：没人和牌时怎么算？
item.description: 牌墙摸完还没人和牌怎么办？「流局」的处理各国玩法差别不小。 — What if the wall runs out with no winner? "Exhaustive draw" rules differ notably across variants.

item.title: 结算与支付：自摸、点炮、流局怎么算钱
item.description: 同样一手牌，自摸和点炮的收入可能差很多。结算规则直接影响你的决策。 — The same hand pays very differently by self-draw vs discard — settlement rules directly shape your decisions.

item.title: 犯规与禁手：这些动作会被罚
item.description: 多抓一张、喊错番、亮错牌……这些犯规在正式对局里可能直接判罚。 — Drawing an extra tile, misclaiming a win, exposing the wrong tile — fouls can cost you in serious play.

item.title: 出牌顺序与优先级：谁先谁后？
item.description: 逆时针轮转、胡大于碰、碰大于吃——顺序规则决定了牌局的公平。 — Counter-clockwise play, win over pung, pung over chow — order rules keep the game fair.

item.title: 自摸与点炮：两种和牌方式的意义
item.description: 同样是和牌，自己摸到和别人打出，价值和风险完全不同。 — Both are wins, but self-drawing vs taking a discard differ completely in value and risk.

item.title: 七对子规则：不起眼的高效牌型
item.description: 不需要面子，只要七个对子。七对子看似简单，实战中却是灵活的偷分手段。 — No melds needed — just seven pairs. Seven pairs looks simple but is a flexible point-grab in practice.

item.title: 国标麻将入门：竞技麻将的标准规则
item.description: 国标（中国标准麻将）是竞技麻将的基石，81 个番种让算分成为技术活儿。 — Chinese Official Mahjong is the competitive baseline — 81 scoring patterns make counting a skill in itself.

item.title: 广东麻将怎么玩？规则与特色
item.description: 三番起和、鸡胡、买马……广东麻将以快节奏和独特算番闻名。 — Three-fan minimum, chicken hands, horse-betting — Cantonese mahjong is known for pace and unique scoring.

item.title: 四川血战到底：不封顶的疯狂玩法
item.description: 一家胡牌，其余照打，直到只剩一家——这就是「血战到底」的刺激。 — One player wins, the rest keep playing until only one remains — the thrill of "bloody battle".

item.title: 上海麻将：清混碰的讲究
item.description: 上海麻将重视清一色、混一色与碰碰胡，节奏别具一格。 — Shanghai mahjong prizes pure one-suit, mixed one-suit and all-triplets, with its own distinctive rhythm.

item.title: 香港麻将怎么玩？规则速览
item.description: 三番起和、花牌计分、无字无花也能尝试——香港麻将自有其节奏。 — Three-fan minimum, flower scoring, and viable honorless hands — Hong Kong mahjong has its own rhythm.

item.title: 台湾麻将：16 张牌的独特玩法
item.description: 台湾麻将每人 16 张牌，起手结构完全不同，是多牌玩法的代表。 — Taiwanese mahjong deals 16 tiles each — a completely different starting structure and a standout multi-tile variant.

item.title: 湖北麻将：红中赖子杠怎么玩
item.description: 「红中赖子杠」是湖北玩法的招牌：红中可当万能牌，杠有特殊计分。 — "Red dragon, joker, kong" is Hubei's signature: the red dragon acts as a wildcard and kongs score specially.

item.title: 长沙麻将：红中与起手的讲究
item.description: 长沙麻将节奏快、门槛低，红中与起手判断是胜负关键。 — Changsha mahjong is fast and low-threshold, with red dragons and opening judgement deciding wins.

item.title: 日本立直麻将入门：役种、立直与点数
item.description: 立直麻将规则严密、防守深度高，是国际上最流行的竞技麻将之一。 — Riichi mahjong is tightly ruled and deeply defensive — one of the most popular competitive variants worldwide.

item.title: 关东与关西麻将的打法差异
item.description: 同是日麻，关东与关西在规则细项与牌桌上却有不少微妙差别。 — Both are riichi, yet Kanto and Kansai differ subtly in rule details and table culture.

item.title: 美国麻将：NMJL 与牌型卡片玩法
item.description: 美国麻将不做任意和牌，而是每年按「牌型卡」指定目标，玩法独树一帜。 — American mahjong rejects free-form wins: each year a "card" sets the target hands — a completely distinct approach.

item.title: 东南亚麻将：新马泰玩法概览
item.description: 新加坡、马来西亚、泰国各有自己的麻将习惯，番种与计分各有特色。 — Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand each have their own mahjong customs, patterns and scoring.

item.title: 武汉麻将：口口翻与赖子的玩法
item.description: 武汉麻将翻倍机制刺激，「口口翻」「赖子」让每局充满变数。 — Wuhan mahjong's multiplier mechanics — stacked doubles and jokers — fill every round with swings.

item.title: 沈阳麻将：东北玩法的节奏
item.description: 东北麻将节奏豪爽，沈阳玩法在番种与计分上有自己的门道。 — Northeast mahjong plays bold and fast; Shenyang's variant has its own take on patterns and scoring.

item.title: 天津麻将：本地番种与打法
item.description: 天津麻将有独特的本地番种与计分习惯，别有风味。 — Tianjin mahjong has distinctive local patterns and scoring habits with its own flavour.

item.title: 日本麻将的地方变体：三麻与规则差异
item.description: 除了标准四人日麻，三麻与各地规则差异也是日麻世界的趣味所在。 — Beyond standard four-player riichi, sanma and regional rules add fun to the riichi world.

item.title: 广东推倒胡：最简快的麻将玩法之一
item.description: 推倒胡副露即胡、节奏极快，是最容易上手的玩法之一。 — Push-down mahjong lets you win on calls and plays lightning-fast — one of the easiest to learn.

item.title: 浙江麻将：玩法分支与特色
item.description: 浙江各地麻将分支众多，杭州、宁波等各有自家规则。 — Zhejiang has many local branches — Hangzhou, Ningbo and others each follow their own rules.

item.title: 平和与断幺九：最常见的基础番种
item.description: 平和与断幺九是出现频率最高的番种，理解它们能让你吃透大部分和牌。 — All-chows and all-simples appear most often — understanding them unlocks most wins.

item.title: 清一色与混一色：花色集中的威力
item.description: 清一色与混一色是高番种的代表，做成一局足以扭转局势。 — Pure and mixed one-suit are top-tier patterns — completing one can swing the whole game.

item.title: 一气通贯（一条龙）：1 到 9 的浪漫
item.description: 同一花色凑出 123、456、789 三组顺子，就是一气通贯——整齐又高分。 — Three runs 123, 456, 789 in one suit make ittsu — tidy and high-scoring.

item.title: 碰碰胡：全刻子的痛快
item.description: 四组刻子加一对将，就是碰碰胡。副露之后往往成型飞快。 — Four triplets plus a pair — that's all-triplets, often quick to complete once you call.

item.title: 七对子与龙七对：算分与区别
item.description: 七对子怎么算分？龙七对又是什么？一文讲清两者的番数差异。 — How is seven pairs scored, and what is dragon seven pairs? Their fan differences, explained.

item.title: 杠上开花：杠出来的额外收益
item.description: 开出杠后补的那张牌正好和牌，就是杠上开花——既惊喜又高分。 — Konging and drawing your winning tile as the replacement is a thrilling, high-scoring bonus.

item.title: 抢杠和：加杠时的致命一击
item.description: 对手加杠的那张牌正好是你等的牌？你就能「抢杠和」，直接拿下这一局。 — If an opponent's added-kong tile is exactly what you wait for, you can "rob the kong" and take the hand.

item.title: 海底捞月：最后一张牌的和牌
item.description: 牌墙摸到最后一张时和牌，就是海底捞月——戏剧性拉满的番种。 — Winning on the very last tile of the wall is a maximum-drama pattern.

item.title: 大三元与小三元：箭牌的极致
item.description: 中、发、白三组刻子凑齐，就是大三元——极高番的梦幻牌型。 — Triplets of red, green and white dragons make big dragons — a dream hand of huge value.

item.title: 大四喜与小四喜：四风的牌型
item.description: 东南西北四风刻子齐了就是大四喜，比大三元更稀有。 — Triplets of all four winds make big winds — even rarer than big dragons.

item.title: 多面听：听得越宽，和得越快
item.description: 同一手牌可能等好几张不同的牌，这就是多面听——和牌率的隐形放大器。 — One hand can wait on several different tiles — a hidden multiplier for your win rate.

item.title: 边张、嵌张、单骑：听牌形态入门
item.description: 听牌不是只有「两边等」一种，理解不同等待形态才能算准张数。 — A wait isn't only two-sided — knowing the wait types lets you count tiles accurately.

item.title: 几向听：判断你离胡牌还有多远
item.description: 一向听、二向听……搞懂「向听」，你就能量化自己离胡牌的距离。 — "One-away", "two-away" — shanten lets you quantify your distance to winning.

item.title: 好形与恶形：面子质量决定效率
item.description: 同样是「差一张的面子」，好形进张多、恶形进张少，效率天差地别。 — Two "one-away melds" can differ hugely: good shapes draw widely, bad shapes draw narrowly.

item.title: 听牌张数怎么算？
item.description: 「我到底等几张？」这是新手最容易算错的问题。掌握方法，一秒就能数清。 — "How many tiles am I waiting on?" is the most commonly miscounted question. Learn the method and count in a second.

item.title: 一色手怎么构建？花色集中的技巧
item.description: 想做清一色却总做不成？问题往往出在起手判断与留牌取舍上。 — Can't finish a pure one-suit? The problem is usually opening judgement and tile retention.

item.title: 顺子还是刻子？面子构成的取舍
item.description: 手牌同时能组顺子或刻子时，选哪个更好？答案取决于速度与番数。 — When a hand can form a run or a triplet, which is better? Speed and value decide.

item.title: 孤张与浮牌：先扔哪张？
item.description: 起手打哪张最不亏？判断孤张与浮牌的价值，是效率的第一课。 — What's the cheapest opening discard? Judging lone tiles and floaters is Efficiency 101.

item.title: 国士无双（十三幺）：最稀有的和牌
item.description: 十三种幺九字牌各一张，再加其中一张重复——这就是传奇般的国士无双。 — One of each terminal and honor type plus a duplicate — the legendary thirteen orphans.

item.title: 九莲宝灯：清一色的极限形态
item.description: 1112345678999 同花色加任意一张，就是九莲宝灯——清一色的巅峰。 — 1112345678999 of one suit plus any tile makes nine gates — the peak of pure one-suit.

item.title: 起手定方向：如何规划一手牌
item.description: 第一巡就该想好这手牌往哪走。起手判断，决定了后面所有的取舍。 — By the first turn you should know where the hand is going. Opening judgement shapes every later choice.

item.title: 牌效：麻将效率的核心概念
item.description: 「打哪张进张最多？」——回答好这个问题，你就掌握了牌效。 — "Which discard keeps the most draws?" — answer that well and you've mastered tile efficiency.

item.title: 舍牌安全与筋牌：怎么打才不点炮
item.description: 后期打哪张最安全？「筋牌」等防守概念能帮你大幅降低点炮率。 — Which late discard is safest? Concepts like "suji" cut your deal-in rate sharply.

item.title: 危险牌预测：读懂对手的听牌
item.description: 为什么总在关键时刻点炮？因为你没读懂对手的「危险信号」。 — Dealing in at the worst moment? You're missing opponents' danger signals.

item.title: 副露还是门清？速度与价值的权衡
item.description: 副露能加速，门清更值钱。到底怎么选？关键看局面需要什么。 — Calling adds speed, concealment adds value. Which to choose depends on what the situation needs.

item.title: 如何读牌：从对手舍牌推断牌型
item.description: 对手打出的每张牌都是线索。学会串联它们，你就能「看到」别人的手牌。 — Every discard is a clue. Learn to connect them and you can "see" opponents' hands.

item.title: 听牌选择：听得多还是听得巧？
item.description: 张数最多的听法未必最好。结合安全与读牌，才能选出最优听牌。 — The widest wait isn't always best. Combining safety and reads yields the optimal wait.

item.title: 攻守判断：什么时候该冲，什么时候该守
item.description: 麻将的分水岭不在技术，而在攻守判断。冲错了，一手好牌也可能全赔进去。 — Mahjong's watershed is judgement, not technique. Push wrongly and one good hand can wipe you out.

item.title: 点数状况策略：领先与落后的不同打法
item.description: 同样是麻将，领先时和落后时的最优策略完全不同。 — Same game, but optimal strategy when ahead differs completely from when behind.

item.title: 牌效的常见误区：你以为的快其实是慢
item.description: 保留对子、拆掉好形、迷恋刻子……这些「想当然」的打法正在拖慢你。 — Keeping pairs, breaking good shapes, loving triplets — these "obvious" plays are slowing you down.

item.title: 立直麻将役种总览：和牌的通行证
item.description: 没有役就不能和牌。搞清楚役种，是玩立直麻将的第一道门槛。 — No yaku, no win. Understanding yaku is riichi's first gate.

item.title: 立直时机：什么时候该宣告听牌
item.description: 报立直能加番，但也会暴露与锁定。什么时候报、什么时候忍，大有讲究。 — Declaring adds value but exposes and locks you. When to declare and when to wait is a real skill.

item.title: 振听规则：为什么对手打出的牌我不能和
item.description: 明明听牌了，别人打出和牌张却不能和？这很可能是「振听」在生效。 — Ready, yet you can't win on a discard? "Furiten" is likely in effect.

item.title: 宝牌（ドラ）：立刻提升手牌价值
